2750.def:
let MiasmaRepo = "Miasma-Open-Source-Release";
let DevTools = dynamic(["git.exe","npm.exe","node.exe","pip.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","git","npm","node","pip","python","python3","curl","wget"]);
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (DevTools) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (DevTools)
    | where ProcessCommandLine contains MiasmaRepo or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains MiasmaRepo
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256, Source = "Process";
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteUrl contains MiasmaRepo
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Source = "Network";
union isfuzzy=true ProcHits, NetHits
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| order by Timestamp desc
2750.sent:
let MiasmaRepo = "Miasma-Open-Source-Release";
let From4688 = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where CommandLine contains MiasmaRepo
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Source = "4688";
let FromAsim = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine contains MiasmaRepo or TargetProcessCommandLine contains MiasmaRepo
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname, Account = ActorUsername, NewProcessName = TargetProcessName, CommandLine = TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName = ActingProcessName, Source = "ASIM";
let FromProxy = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where RequestURL contains MiasmaRepo or DestinationHostName contains MiasmaRepo
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = SourceHostName, Account = SourceUserName, NewProcessName = "", CommandLine = RequestURL, ParentProcessName = "", Source = "Proxy";
union From4688, FromAsim, FromProxy
| where Account !endswith "$"
| order by TimeGenerated desc

2753.def:
let Window = 1m;
let BurstThreshold = 20;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where RemotePort in (443, 22, 8443) and InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("httpsd", "sshd", "cli")
| summarize Calls = count(), FirstT = min(Timestamp), LastT = max(Timestamp) by RemoteIP, DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| extend DurationSec = datetime_diff('second', LastT, FirstT), RatePerSec = todouble(Calls) / (todouble(datetime_diff('second', LastT, FirstT)) + 1)
| where Calls >= BurstThreshold and (RatePerSec >= 2.0 or DurationSec <= 10)
| order by Timestamp desc

2755.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — OceanLotus Hits Vietnam Investors With SPECTRALVIPER in FireAnt Attack
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("metakit.exe", "dtlcrashcatch.dll", "onedrive.sync.service.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("metakit.exe", "dtlcrashcatch.dll", "onedrive.sync.service.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named

| where (FileName in~ ("metakit.exe", "dtlcrashcatch.dll", "intelaudioservice.exe", "dtlupdate.exe", "onedrive.sync.service.exe", "genuine.exe", "updater.exe", "autocad242.exe", "toolbox.exe", "setupui.dll"))

2784.def:
let WindowSeconds = 60;
let Execs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FolderPath startswith "/tmp/" or FolderPath startswith "/var/run/" or FolderPath startswith "/dev/shm/" or FolderPath startswith "/var/tmp/"
    | project ExecTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ExecPath=FolderPath, ExecFile=FileName, SHA256;
let Deletes = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "FileDeleted"
    | where FolderPath startswith "/tmp/" or FolderPath startswith "/var/run/" or FolderPath startswith "/dev/shm/" or FolderPath startswith "/var/tmp/"
    | project DelTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DelPath=FolderPath, DelFile=FileName;
Execs
| join kind=inner Deletes on DeviceId
| where DelPath == ExecPath and DelFile == ExecFile
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', DelTime, ExecTime)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSeconds)
| project DeviceName, AccountName, ExecTime, DelTime, DelaySec, ExecPath, ExecFile, SHA256
| order by ExecTime desc
2784.sent:
let WindowSeconds = 60;
let Execs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)

    | project ExecTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ExecPath=ActingProcessName, MD5, SHA256;

    | project DelTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DelPath=TargetFilePath;
Execs
| join kind=inner Deletes on DvcHostname
| where DelPath == ExecPath
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', DelTime, ExecTime)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSeconds)

// Article-specific bespoke detection — Wait, binding.gyp Can Do What? Exploring npm's Weirdest Build System
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js", "evil.js", "evil_script.js", "malicious.js", "evil.sh", "cc-evil.sh", "evil-wrapper.sh", "cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/dev/null", "/usr/bin/cc") or FileName in~ ("index.js", "node.js", "evil.js", "evil_script.js", "malicious.js", "evil.sh", "cc-evil.sh", "evil-wrapper.sh", "cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2839.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Wait, binding.gyp Can Do What? Exploring npm's Weirdest Build System ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("index.js","node.js","evil.js","evil_script.js","malicious.js","evil.sh","cc-evil.sh","evil-wrapper.sh","cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/bin/cc*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("index.js","node.js","evil.js","evil_script.js","malicious.js","evil.sh","cc-evil.sh","evil-wrapper.sh","cc-evil-wrapper.sh"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

id: 7f3b6c2a-d4e1-4a01-9c5e-3a4f1c8e7b22
description: Detects node-gyp's Python parser (gyp.py) spawning unexpected child processes during npm install, indicative of GYP command-expansion abuse used by the Miasma v2 / Phantom Gyp worm (June 2026)
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/exploring-binding-gyp-npm-build-system
  - https://semgrep.dev/blog/2026/miasma-v2-self-spreading-npm-worm-now-uses-malicious-bindinggyp-file-and-compromises-57-packages/
  - https://www.endorlabs.com/learn/malicious-payload-in-ai-sdk-ollama-npm-package
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_python_gyp:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'gyp.py'
      - 'node-gyp'
      - 'binding.gyp'
  suspicious_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  suspicious_child_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'index.js'
      - '__subclasses__'
      - 'catch_warnings'
      - 'echo stub.c'
      - "__import__('os')"
      - 'pymod_do_main'
  filter_compilers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cl.exe'
      - '\link.exe'
      - '\cmake.exe'
      - '\msbuild.exe'
      - '\gcc.exe'
      - '\clang.exe'
      - '\make.exe'
      - '\nmake.exe'
  condition: parent_python_gyp and (suspicious_child_image or suspicious_child_cmdline) and not filter_compilers
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate packages whose binding.gyp uses <!(node ...) for non-malicious build-time configuration (e.g. node-pre-gyp version probing)

id: 1c3e8a2d-7f4b-4e1c-aa72-9d2b6e3c5f88
description: Detects MSTI-reported Anthropic-impersonating phishing wave (Apr 2026) carrying the 'Fill and Sign Claude Appeal Form.pdf' AiTM lure attachment.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/06/08/ai-brands-as-bait-how-threat-actors-are-using-the-ai-hype-in-social-engineering/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1557
  - attack.t1656
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: threat_management
  category: email
detection:
  selection_attach:
    AttachmentFileName|contains:
      - 'Fill and Sign Claude Appeal Form.pdf'
      - 'Claude Appeal Form.pdf'
  selection_subject:
    Subject|contains: 'Claude Appeal Request'
  selection_display:
    SenderDisplayName:
      - 'Anthropic Teams'
      - 'Anthropic PBC'
  filter_legit:
    SenderFromDomain|endswith: 'anthropic.com'
  condition: (selection_attach or (selection_subject and selection_display)) and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Anthropic trust-and-safety communications (filtered via anthropic.com sender domain)
level: high
2860.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Email where (Email.src_user_display IN ("Anthropic Teams","Anthropic PBC") OR Email.subject="*Claude Appeal Request*" OR Email.file_name="Fill and Sign Claude Appeal Form.pdf") by Email.src_user, Email.src_user_display, Email.recipient, Email.subject, Email.file_name, Email.message_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Email)` | search (src_user_display IN ("Anthropic Teams","Anthropic PBC") OR file_name="Fill and Sign Claude Appeal Form.pdf") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`

2861.def:
let ioc_domains = dynamic(["legendarytrendsbay.shop","dash.awaydouble.org","awaydouble.org","servicing.pureplantcravings.com","pureplantcravings.com","brokeapt.com","pan.ssffaa19.xyz","ssffaa19.xyz"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(60d)
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| extend host = tolower(tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host))
| where host in (ioc_domains)
    or RemoteUrl has_any (ioc_domains)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, host, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, ActionType
| order by Timestamp desc
2861.sent:
let ioc_domains = dynamic(["legendarytrendsbay.shop","dash.awaydouble.org","awaydouble.org","servicing.pureplantcravings.com","pureplantcravings.com","brokeapt.com","pan.ssffaa19.xyz","ssffaa19.xyz"]);
union isfuzzy=true
    (ImDnsActivity
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(60d)
        | where tolower(DnsQuery) in (ioc_domains) or DnsQuery has_any (ioc_domains)
        | project TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, Indicator = DnsQuery, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventKind = "dns"),
    (ImWebSession
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(60d)

        | project TimeGenerated, SrcHostname = SourceHostName, SrcIpAddr = SourceIP, SrcUsername = SourceUserName, Indicator = coalesce(DestinationHostName, RequestURL), EventVendor = DeviceVendor, EventProduct = DeviceProduct, EventKind = "firewall")

2864.sigma:
title: Vulnerable cordova-plugin-inappbrowser install (CVE-2026-47430)
id: 8e6c4b8a-3d2a-4e6f-9d7b-1c0e2a4b8d6a
description: |
  Detects npm / yarn / pnpm / cordova / ionic CLI invocations that install
  cordova-plugin-inappbrowser in a version range vulnerable to CVE-2026-47430
  (3.1.0 through 6.0.0). Pinned safe versions (>=6.0.1) are excluded.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q42j-x8rq-pjg6
author: Detection engineering
date: 2026/06/14
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.001
  - cve.2026.47430
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\npm.cmd'
      - '\npx.exe'
      - '\yarn.exe'
      - '\pnpm.exe'
      - '\cordova.cmd'
      - '\cordova.exe'
      - '\ionic.cmd'
      - '\node.exe'
  selection_pkg:
    CommandLine|contains: 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser'
  selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' install'
      - ' add'
      - ' plugin add'
  filter_safe_pin:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.0.1'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.0.2'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@6.1'
      - 'cordova-plugin-inappbrowser@7'
  filter_uninstall:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' uninstall'

  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/hypotheses-telemetry-and-human-judgment-inside-cisco-talos-threat-hunting/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_fetch:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'iwr '
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'DownloadString'
  selection_file:
    CommandLine|contains: 'script.ps1'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'AppData'
      - 'ApplicationData'
      - '\Roaming\'
      - '\Local\'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate internal scripts that happen to fetch a file named script.ps1 into AppData (rare; review user context)
level: high
2897.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*iwr *" OR Processes.process="*Net.WebClient*") Processes.process="*script.ps1*" (Processes.process="*AppData*" OR Processes.process="*ApplicationData*" OR Processes.process="*\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Local\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2897.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND (@CommandLine:(*Invoke-WebRequest* OR *iwr\ * OR *Net.WebClient* OR *DownloadFile* OR *DownloadString*)) AND @CommandLine:*script.ps1* AND (@CommandLine:(*AppData* OR *ApplicationData* OR *\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Local\\*))
2897.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(Invoke-WebRequest|iwr |Net\.WebClient|DownloadFile|DownloadString)", field=CommandLine)

id: 8a3b1f29-7c5e-4d2a-b8f1-9e2c4a6d8b3f
description: Detects node.exe running the mcp-remote npm package spawning a shell or PowerShell child, indicative of CVE-2025-6514 OAuth authorization_endpoint command injection exploited by a malicious MCP server.

author: Detection Engineering

tags:

logsource:

2903.sent:
// Detects KERNEL_* env-var with YAML-injection markers in EG application syslog or WAF body logs.
// CommonSecurityLog does NOT carry DeviceName — use DestinationHostName / SourceIP for host pivots.
let InjectionMarkers = @"(?i)KERNEL_[A-Z_]+[^\n]{0,200}(---|\.\.\.|securityContext|runAsUser|runAsGroup|fsGroup|privileged\s*:\s*true)";
union isfuzzy=true
(
  Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where ProcessName has_any ("enterprise_gateway", "enterprise-gateway", "jupyter") or SyslogMessage has "/api/kernels"
  | where SyslogMessage matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="Syslog", Host=Computer, HostName, ProcessName, Evidence=SyslogMessage
),
(
  CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where RequestURL has "/api/kernels" and RequestMethod =~ "POST"
  | where Message matches regex InjectionMarkers or DeviceCustomString1 matches regex InjectionMarkers or AdditionalExtensions matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="WAF/Proxy", Host=DestinationHostName, SourceIP=SourceIP, ProcessName=DeviceProduct, Evidence=coalesce(Message, DeviceCustomString1, AdditionalExtensions)
),
(
  W3CIISLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where csUriStem == "/api/kernels" and csMethod =~ "POST"
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="IIS", Host=Computer, SourceIP=cIP, ProcessName="w3wp", Evidence=strcat(csMethod, " ", csUriStem, "?", csUriQuery)
)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2903.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method="POST" Web.url="*/api/kernels*" by Web.src, Web.dest, Web.url, Web.http_user_agent, Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| join type=inner src dest [ search (sourcetype=nginx:plus:access OR sourcetype=ingress:nginx OR sourcetype=kube:container:enterprise-gateway OR sourcetype=istio:envoy:access) "/api/kernels" "KERNEL_" ("---" OR "..." OR "securityContext" OR "runAsUser" OR "fsGroup" OR "privileged") | table _time src dest _raw ]
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime, lastTime, src, dest, url, http_user_agent, status

    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

let bunUrlIndicators = dynamic(["github.com/oven-sh/bun", "oven-sh/bun/releases", "bun-windows-x64", "bun-linux-x64", "bun-darwin"]);
let npmParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"]);
let downloaderChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
// Process-tree pivot — npm parent spawning a downloader child with Bun URL on the command line
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents)
    | where FileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
// Network pivot — same process families connecting to github.com for the Bun release tarball
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where RemoteUrl has "github.com" and (RemoteUrl has "oven-sh/bun" or RemoteUrl has "bun-windows" or RemoteUrl has "bun-linux" or RemoteUrl has "bun-darwin")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (npmParents)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage   = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = "<network-egress>", ChildCmd = RemoteUrl, SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
union ProcHits, NetHits
| order by Timestamp desc

let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where HttpMethod =~ "PATCH"
| where Url matches regex @"(?i)/workspaces/[^/]+/members/[^/?#]+"
| where HttpStatusCode in ("200","204")
| extend Workspace = extract(@"(?i)/workspaces/([^/]+)/members/", 1, Url)

| summarize PatchCount = count(),
            TargetsTouched = dcount(TargetUser),
